name: Cait Conley
summary:
Caitlin Conley (born 1985/1986) is an American politician and national security official who served 18 years in the U.S. Army. She is the Democratic member-elect for the U.S. House of Representatives in New York's 17th district after defeating incumbent Republican Mike Lawler in the 2026 election.
Conley served as an officer in the U.S. Army for 16 years with overseas deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan.
